PayReceive.description:
Direction for instrument legs (universal for IRS, CDS, variance swaps, etc.)

For interest rate swaps: Pay = pay fixed/receive floating, Receive = receive fixed/pay floating
For credit default swaps: Pay = buy protection (pay premium), Receive = sell protection (receive premium)
For variance swaps: Pay = short variance, Receive = long variance

oneOf.description: Pay the primary leg (fixed rate in IRS, protection premium in CDS, short variance)
Receive the primary leg (fixed rate in IRS, protection premium in CDS, long variance)

description: Trade terms (id, notional, side, dates, recovery, curves) of a standard-convention CDS index trade.

credit_curve_id.description: Hazard (credit) curve identifier for the protection leg.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve identifier for both legs.

notional.description: Contract notional; its currency is the premium and protection currency.

recovery_rate.description: Assumed recovery as a decimal fraction of par in `[0, 1]` (0.40 = 40%).

side.description: Protection direction: `pay` buys protection (pays premium), `receive` sells it.
